div.head: Abt 46
div.ab: Gif hit sio an hleore, III scill' gebete.
Gif hit sio an hleore, III scill' gebete.
Gif hit sio an hleore, III sciƚƚ gebete.
Wenn es in der Wange ist, büsse er 3 Schill.
If it is in the cheek, let him pay 3 shillings.
If it is one cheek, 3 shillings shall be paid as compensation.
If it [i.e., the piercing] should be on the cheek, let him pay [with] 3 shillings.

note.seg: Mittelengl. -e s. Wb 56 Sp. 3 n. 2a. Bessere: ‘wenn es éine Wange ist’ im Ggs. zu beiden, wie o. 37¹ Anm.
Middle English -e see Wb 56 col. 3 n. 2a. Correct to: ‘if it is one cheek’, as opposed to both, as above 37¹ note.

Das Wort steht für mala, maxilla, gena, facies, vultus (Toller; Sweet Oldest texts), aber nicht für ‘Nasenflügel’. Auch aus den Compositis, dem Mittelengl. lere, dem Altsächs. hlier und Nord. hlýr erhellt die Bed. ‘Backe’ (s. d. Gl 1. 2)

The word stands for mala, maxilla, gena, facies, vultus (Toller; Sweet Oldest texts), but not for ‘wing of the nose’. The meaning ‘cheek’ is also clear from the compounds, from Middle English lere, Old Saxon hlier and Norse hlýr (see that word in Gl 1. 2)
